indexers.title: Indexers
indexers.intro: The indexers this server asks for releases. A search goes out to every one of them at once; the ones that answer fastest fill the results in first.
indexers.none: No indexer is configured yet, so a search can only find what is already in the library. Add one below.
indexers.confirmRemoval: Remove {{name}}? Searches stop going to it, and every release Pornarr had cached from it is discarded along with the row.
indexers.addHint: Give the base URL of the indexer's API and the key it issued you. Test it afterwards to read back the categories it offers.
indexers.name: Name
indexers.apiKeyHint: The key is stored encrypted and never shown again.
indexers.apiKeyKeepHint: Leave the key blank to keep the one already stored. Typing a new one replaces it.

rootFolders.title: Root folders
rootFolders.intro: The folders this instance keeps its media in. Every import, whether it came from a request or from a monitor, is placed inside one of them.
rootFolders.none: No root folder is configured yet, so there is nowhere to import media to. Add one below.
rootFolders.differentFilesystem: This folder is on a different filesystem from downloads, so imports copy the file instead of hardlinking it.
rootFolders.lowSpace: A low disk space warning has been sent for this folder.
rootFolders.confirmRemoval: Remove {{path}}? Pornarr stops importing into it. Nothing on disk is deleted, and a folder that still holds media cannot be removed.
rootFolders.addHint: Give the absolute path as the server sees it. The folder has to exist already, and Pornarr has to be able to read and write it.

quality.title: Quality profiles
quality.intro: Set the qualities and release properties this instance accepts. Previewing uses the unsaved editor values, so every score and rule is explained before it is stored.
quality.profileHint: Profiles can be selected by monitors and requests.
quality.profileEditorHint: Order qualities by preference. Drag rows or use the buttons so the same order works with a keyboard.
quality.orderHint: The first row is the least preferred; later qualities are higher quality.
quality.cutoffHint: After {{quality}} has been reached, an existing file is not automatically replaced by a higher-scoring release.
quality.customFormatsHint: Give human-readable release properties a score. Conditions are evaluated together for required rules; optional rules match when any one applies.
quality.noFormatsBody: Add a format to reward or penalize a release property.
quality.conditionsHint: Choose familiar release properties, an operation and a value. For example: Codec equals hevc.
quality.previewHint: Paste a release name to see the detected quality, matching custom formats, score and decision without consulting documentation.
quality.noMatchedFormats: No custom formats matched this release.

reason.quality_not_detected: No allowed quality could be detected from this release name.

errorSteps.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Check the username and password, then sign in again.
errorSteps.NOT_AUTHENTICATED: Sign in again to carry on where you left off.
errorSteps.FORBIDDEN: Ask an administrator for access, or go back to the library.
errorSteps.CSRF_FAILED: Reload the page, then repeat the action.
errorSteps.LOGIN_RATE_LIMITED: Wait a minute, then try again.
errorSteps.OIDC_DISCOVERY_FAILED: Check the issuer address in settings, then try again.
errorSteps.WEB_ASSETS_MISSING: Rebuild or reinstall the application image.
errorSteps.NOT_IMPLEMENTED: Pick another destination from the navigation.
errorSteps.CONFIGURATION_INVALID: Correct the settings named in the server log, then restart the server.
errorSteps.DECRYPTION_FAILED: Restore the original application secret, or enter the credential again.
errorSteps.QUALITY_CONFIGURATION_INVALID: Check the selected qualities, cutoff and names, then save again.
errorSteps.QUALITY_PROFILE_IN_USE: Choose another default profile or move the monitors to another profile first.
errorSteps.ROOT_FOLDER_INVALID: Check the path on the server, then enter one that exists and is not configured already.
errorSteps.ROOT_FOLDER_HAS_MEDIA: Move or delete the media in that folder on the server first, then remove it here.
errorSteps.SETUP_REQUIRED: Finish the setup steps before using the application.
errorSteps.SETUP_ALREADY_COMPLETED: Sign in with the administrator account that already exists.
errorSteps.SETUP_PATH_INVALID: Choose an existing folder that Pornarr can read and write.
errorSteps.BAD_REQUEST: Change what was sent and try once more.
errorSteps.NOT_FOUND: Pick a destination from the navigation.
errorSteps.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: Go back and choose a different action.
errorSteps.CONFLICT: Open what already exists, or choose a different name.
errorSteps.VALIDATION_FAILED: Correct the highlighted fields, then submit again.
errorSteps.RATE_LIMITED: Wait a moment, then try again.
errorSteps.INTERNAL_ERROR: Try again. If it keeps happening, check the server log.
errorSteps.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: Wait for the server to finish starting, then try again.
errorSteps.NETWORK_UNREACHABLE: Check that the server is running and reachable, then try again.
errorSteps.SETUP_PASSWORD_TOO_WEAK: Use at least 12 characters from two kinds: lower case, upper case, digits, symbols.
errorSteps.ROOT_FOLDER_DISABLED: Enable that root folder in the administration area, or choose another one.
errorSteps.OIDC_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED: Start the sign-in again, or sign in with a username and password instead.
errorSteps.OIDC_STATE_INVALID: Go back to the sign-in screen and start the sign-in again in this browser.
errorSteps.OIDC_IDENTITY_NOT_ALLOWED: Ask an administrator to allow this identity, or sign in with another account.
errorSteps.OIDC_IDENTITY_ALREADY_LINKED: Sign in as that account and unlink it first, or link a different provider account.
errorSteps.OIDC_USERNAME_CONFLICT: Sign in to the local account and link the provider from there, or ask an administrator to rename one of them.
errorSteps.OIDC_UNLINK_WOULD_LOCK_ACCOUNT: Set a password or link another provider first, then unlink this one.
errorSteps.USER_CANNOT_DEACTIVATE_SELF: Ask another administrator to deactivate it, so somebody keeps access to this instance.
errorSteps.INDEXER_CONNECTION_FAILED: Check the base URL and API key, and that the indexer is running, then test it again.
errorSteps.DOWNLOAD_CLIENT_CONNECTION_FAILED: Check the host, port and credentials, and that the client is running, then test it again.
errorSteps.DOWNLOAD_CLIENT_UNAVAILABLE: Add or repair a download client for that protocol, then try again.
errorSteps.TORZNAB_RESPONSE_INVALID: Check the indexer's base URL and API key, then test the connection again.
errorSteps.STASHDB_RESPONSE_INVALID: Check the StashDB key and endpoint in the administration area, then try again.
errorSteps.TPDB_RESPONSE_INVALID: Check the ThePornDB key and endpoint in the administration area, then try again.
errorSteps.PEER_UNAVAILABLE: Check that the peer is online and still trusts this instance, then try again.
errorSteps.REQUEST_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: Wait for a request to finish, or cancel one, before requesting another.
errorSteps.REQUEST_ACTION_INVALID: Reload the request and choose an action its current state allows.
errorSteps.REQUEST_NOT_GRABBABLE: Reload the request; if it is already downloading, cancel it before grabbing another release.
errorSteps.REQUEST_CANCELLATION_FAILED: Try again. If it keeps failing, cancel the download in the client itself.
errorSteps.REQUEST_CONTROL_FAILED: Try again. If it keeps failing, check the download client's own log.
errorSteps.REQUEST_PRIORITY_UPDATE_FAILED: Try again. If it keeps failing, change the priority in the download client itself.
errorSteps.RELEASE_NOT_FOUND: Search again, then grab the release from the fresh results.
errorSteps.RELEASE_EXPIRED: Search again, then grab the release from the fresh results.
errorSteps.RELEASE_BLOCKED: Choose another release, or clear the blocklist entry before grabbing this one again.
errorSteps.RELEASE_IN_LIBRARY: Open the title in the library instead of downloading it again.
errorSteps.RELEASE_FILTERED: Choose another release, or change the filter rule that rejects it.
errorSteps.RELEASE_PROTOCOL_UNSUPPORTED: Add a download client for that protocol, then grab the release again.
errorSteps.GRAB_SUBMISSION_FAILED: Try again. If it keeps failing, check the download client's own log.
errorSteps.MONITOR_QUALITY_PROFILE_REQUIRED: Create or select a quality profile, then save the monitor again.
errorSteps.MONITOR_ALREADY_EXISTS: Open the monitor that already exists instead of creating a second one.
errorSteps.QUARANTINE_REVIEW_INVALID: Preview the bulk action first, and list every item once under the selected reason.
errorSteps.COLLECTION_ALREADY_EXISTS: Choose a different name, or open the collection that already exists.
errorSteps.SEND_ALREADY_EXISTS: Open the send you already made instead of sending the title twice.
errorSteps.SHORT_ALREADY_EXISTS: Choose a different start point, or edit the short that is already there.
errorSteps.SHORTS_NO_MARKERS: Add scene markers to the title first, then generate shorts from them.
errorSteps.TRANSCODE_LIMIT_REACHED: Wait for a transcode to finish, then start playback again.
errorSteps.RANGE_NOT_SATISFIABLE: Reload the page, then start playback again.
errorSteps.FILTER_CONFIGURATION_INVALID: Give a text rule something to match on, leave a file-property rule's pattern empty, and set a minimum confidence between 0 and 1.
errorSteps.unknown: Try again, and quote this code if it keeps happening.
errorSteps.generic: Try again. If it keeps happening, reload the page.
